fix(motion): read a self-crossing leftover cusp by the even-odd rule in the corner check

On the finer solidcore mesh the leftover of a bore beside a stock
corner keeps a micron-wide bow-tie cusp. connected_pieces read each
outer loop with Region::new, which refuses a loop that crosses itself,
so the corner check said "did not run". The loop is boolean output, so
outer_fills now reads it with Region::from_slices. A simple loop gives
the same single path either way.

Pins: unreached::law::a_micron_bow_tie_cusp_gives_its_lobes_and_no_error
and lead_approach::the_users_pocket_names_its_seven_sharp_corners_and_the_corner_check_runs.

Refs #2849

fix(kernel): bound the STEP face winding check

face_of followed ORIENTED_FACE without a depth limit: a wrapper that
names itself overflowed the stack on every STEP import, before the
reader could refuse the file. It now reads at most 4 wrappers, as
edge_of does; a deeper chain gives the shell no note.

The parity union-find gets union by size and full path compression, so
a hostile edge order no longer costs quadratic time. The pass reads the
import's cancel token for each shell member and stops with the
reader's time-out refusal (stage "checking face winding").

Pinned by kernel lib step_face_winding::tests and machining_mesh_open
(an ORIENTED_FACE that names itself, a chain of 64).

Refs #917
